sources.text: Kilkenny | National Parks & Wildlife Service Skip to main content Home About NPWS Work with the NPWS Contact Us Accessibility National Parks & Wildlife Service National Parks Protected Sites Nature Reserves Publications Licences Maps and Data Planning You are here Home > Nature Reserves > Kilkenny Clare Cork Donegal Dublin Galway Kerry Kildare Kilkenny Laois Mayo Meath Offaly Sligo Tipperary Westmeath Wexford Wicklow Kilkenny Ballykeeffe Wood Nature Reserve Location: 12 km south-west of Kilkenny situated on a prominent limestone hill. GPS: Latitude: 52.612 Longitude: -7.394 Area (ha.): 55.4 Animals and plants of interest: A young ash woodland with pedunculate oak and abundant bramble and bluebells. Established: Ownership: State-owned Fiddown Island Nature Reserve Location: 7 km east of Carrick-on-Suir. GPS: Latitude: 53.068 Longitude: -7.93 Area (ha.): 21 Animals and plants of interest: An alluvial woodland dominated by tree willows formerly used for basket making. The vegetation is characterised by tall herbs, sedges and grasses. It is covered in willow scrub and bordered by reed swamps - the only known site of its type in Ireland. Established: 1988 Ownership: State-owned Garryricken Woods Nature Reserve Location: 6 km south-west of Callan GPS: Latitude: 52.497 Longitude: -7.412 Area (ha.): 28 Animals and plants of interest: This reserve consists of two parts and contains a mixture of ash, oak and birch woodland on a variety of soil types. Established: Ownership: State-owned Kyledohir Wood Nature Reserve Location: 5 km south-west of Callan. GPS: Latitude: 52.533 Longitude: -7.453 Area (ha.): 59 Animals and plants of interest: Mixed, young oak-ash-elm woodland on a low-lying site with moisture-loving species.
